pages.text: Each bond formed links two pieces; when a fraction p of the ends have reacted, the chains average 1/(1 − p) units (Carothers). So long chains need almost every bond: 0.99 for a hundred units, 0.999 for a thousand. Hotter is faster; the reaction gives out heat, and above its limit it runs away.
$(thing)Set$(): Conversion, Temperature.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Impurities: the conversion reached varies by ±0.01%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The polymerisation is running away.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Longer chains take longer; hotter goes faster.
